mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Verona City Hall at 39 degrees. We expect an overnight low of 38 degrees with no rain predicted.

City news includes upcoming pavement work on Tuesday and Wednesday at several local streets including Nine Mound Road and Edward Street, plus the Plan Commission is reviewing new development projects at Liberty Business Park.
There is plenty to do with the Dane County Farmers Market today, live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's today, and local trivia nights coming up at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee next Tuesday.
In our weekly police report, on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for an O W I after he was found stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
It is a great day to stop by for a scoop of Really Reese's. The shop is open until 10:30 PM tonight, so stop in before they close for the evening.
